note: D-A11Y-1's fix rests on a MEASUREMENT, and a measurement has a platform. This file records that platform so the fix cannot outlive its own evidence. Until 2026-11-01 its `platform` was the one a DEFERRAL rested on (no Quickshell window published a tree, so the unmasked fields reached nobody); the system update of 2026-10-31 expired that premise, a dated exception covered the new platform while D-A11Y-1 was fixed, and on 2026-11-01 the premise was re-measured as the fix's.
premise: On this platform a Sources form field publishes a masked value, never the provider credentials it holds: the drawn TextField is Accessible.StaticText and ignored, and a sibling Item with the role EditableText is the field on the bus, publishing Model.fieldAccessibleValue. Observed by scripts/a11y-probe.sh in a plain Window for the Xtream server, username and password, unrevealed (L2-XT-05, -06 and -07 pass); the playlist and EPG URL fields and any revealed state are held by the node checks on Model.fieldAccessibleValue, not observed at the sink. The drawn field's text-change events go, by the Qt 6.12.0 sources, to the nearest EditableText ancestor, and a search of the shipped QML and the host kit finds none; that half is read, not observed.
upstream: quickshell#1144 (OUR report, closed 2026-09-21 with no comment). Cause confirmed and FIXED upstream at quickshell-mirror/quickshell@916a0dd, authored 2026-08-28: 'launch: avoid creating multiple QApplications -- Accessibility hooks created by QQuick module init are destroyed by the QApplication destructor and not recreated by a new QApplication.' Released in v0.3.2 (GitHub compare, 2026-10-31: v0.3.2 is 15 commits ahead of it, 0 behind); on 2026-09-25 it was in no release (latest v0.3.1, published 2026-08-21, a week before the fix). Verified against the GitHub API 2026-09-25; see docs/ACCESSIBILITY-INVESTIGATION.md section 10. Installed since the system update of 2026-10-31: quickshell 0.3.2.r7.g2b4501a-1 contains 916a0dd (checked per onRed that day; see the exception record in docs/ACCESSIBILITY-INVESTIGATION.md section 10).
measuredIn: scripts/a11y-probe.sh on the merged tree, 2026-11-01 (docs/QA-RESULTS.md, "D-A11Y-1 merged"); the history before the fix is docs/ACCESSIBILITY-INVESTIGATION.md sections 6 and 10
whyItMatters: D-A11Y-1 was fixed by relying on two Qt behaviours: which text an item with the role EditableText publishes as its Value (a TextInput's displayText, any other item's `text` property), and that a TextInput raises its text-change events, raw old and new text included, only to the nearest EditableText object up its parents. A Qt or Quickshell update can change either, and nothing in check.sh would notice: the probe needs a graphical session and is not in the gate. If either changes, the Xtream server and username, and a playlist or EPG URL, could publish their credentials to every listener on the session bus again.
notADetector: This does NOT detect that the masking broke. It detects that the EVIDENCE HAS EXPIRED, which is the honest and cheap thing to detect: a version change is the event after which the probe's last run no longer describes this machine, so it is the moment to re-run the probe rather than to assume.
onRed: Re-run scripts/a11y-probe.sh under the nested headless cage on a private D-Bus (CLAUDE.md rule 6b); its baseline is the set in tests/a11y/check_bus.py. If L2-XT-05, L2-XT-06 or L2-XT-07 fails, D-A11Y-1 is REOPENED: nothing ships until the field values are masked again, and the board row says so. If they pass, update the versions below and say in measuredIn where it was re-measured. A Quickshell build without 916a0dd publishes no tree at all, which is safe; the probe hosts the guide in a plain Window either way, so it shows what the guide publishes, not whether a PanelWindow does.
